=== FRONTEND-ONLY OPERATING RULES FOR THE AGENT ===
1. Modify only files inside the detected frontend root(s).
2. Backend source code is strictly read-only.
3. Do not modify .cs, .csproj, .sln, .slnx, SQL, migrations, Docker backend files,
   server configuration, controllers, services, domain entities, repositories,
   authorization policies, or backend tests.
4. Do not invent API endpoints, fields, permissions, or business rules.
5. Preserve existing API contracts and role-based access behavior.
6. A user must only see functionality permitted for that user role.
7. Before editing, identify the design system, route structure, shared components,
   API client, authentication flow, state management, and responsive conventions.
8. Work in small frontend-only commits and run lint, type-check, tests, and build.
9. After every change, verify that git diff contains no backend modification.
10. Use screenshots at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths for visual QA.
